applicabilityBasis.summary: MUSD is a Bridge-issued U.S. dollar payment stablecoin for MetaMask using M0 infrastructure and 1:1 redemption.

genius.licensingRegulator: FinCEN / state money transmitter regulators (NMLS #2450917); OCC conditionally approved a new entity 'Bridge National Trust Bank' (CD-1365, Feb 2026): not yet a final federal charter for Bridge Building Inc.
genius.notes: MetaMask names Bridge as mUSD issuer and M0 as underlying minting infrastructure. Bridge stablecoin terms identify Bridge Building Inc. as issuer and establish USD 1 redemption for eligible onboarded users, subject to disclosed fees and restrictions. Bridge Open Issuance describes GENIUS-ready compliance; this supports issuer-announced-intent rather than completed qualification. OCC Decision 1365 is preliminary conditional charter approval for proposed Bridge National Trust Bank, a separate entity organized by Bridge Ventures LLC. The reviewed public record did not establish a token-specific GENIUS approval or legal issuer transfer for mUSD. Ordinary Bridge Building Inc. FinCEN/state registrations and the Bridge Building S.A. European entity do not establish that status. issuerPathway remains unknown on the token-specific evidence. The reserve explainer says mUSD attestation history is still being built; no confirmed monthly independent reserve report was located. The M0 dashboard describes the underlying reserve infrastructure and rendered a shell; no live reserve values were extracted.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the checked public regulator and issuer sources did not identify a qualifying GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified designation, official GENIUS application or registered foreign-issuer exception for MetaMask USD / Bridge Building Inc. This finding concerns the reviewed public record and does not exclude confidential or unpublished filings. Ordinary licenses and affiliate charter decisions are separate from token-specific GENIUS authorization.
